images.title: Red tokens win
images.purpose: Show that 5 green tokens and 8 red tokens make 5 zero pairs, leaving 3 red tokens, so (+5) + (−8) = −3.
images.composition: One row of 5 stacked pairs on the left, a gap, then 3 loose red tokens on the right, with one result label below.
images.exact_structure: Left group: 5 vertical pairs side by side, each pair a green token (teal #0072B2) directly above a red token (reddish purple #CC79A7), joined by a short grey #6B7280 link. Right group: 3 extra red tokens in a line, ringed in amber #E69F00. All tokens equal round size, evenly spaced. Exactly 5 green tokens, 8 red tokens, 5 pairs, 3 ringed.

images.takeaway: The colour left over gives the sign of the answer.
images.description: 5 green and 8 red tokens: 5 green-red pairs cancel and 3 red tokens are left, labelled −3.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the pairs, then at what is left and say its sign.

image_decisions.why: Tokens of different signs cancelling is a picture idea; one pairs-and-leftover picture carries it.
